```{r Explore station data}
## Stations ====
Stn_lst <- lapply(d_files, function(file)read_excel(file, sheet=excel_sheets(file)[2]))
names(Stn_lst) <- gsub("\\.xlsx","",basename(d_files))

Stn_lst <- lapply(Stn_lst, function(df) {
  names(df) <- tolower(names(df)) # Lowercase column names
  names(df) <- gsub("\\.x","",names(df))
  df})
col_freq <- table(unlist(lapply(Stn_lst, names)))
sort(col_freq)
names(col_freq[col_freq >= length(Stn_lst)]) # These columns occur in every excel file
names(col_freq[col_freq > 1])

metacols <- c("station","year","month","longitude","latitude","depth","gear","replicates","pressure_type","pressure_value","habitat_type")
basecols <- c(metacols,
              names(col_freq)[
                grepl("total_biom|total_abun|shannon|simpson|invsimpson|medlong|fraclong|sos|longlivedbiomass_to_ref|richness|margalef",
                      names(col_freq))])
indcols <- basecols[!basecols %in% metacols]

Stn_dt <- rbindlist(
  lapply(Stn_lst, function(x) x[, intersect(basecols, names(x)), drop = FALSE]), # select basecols when existing
  idcol = T,
  fill = TRUE) # pressure_value1 and pressure_value2 do not exist in most datafiles

to_table1 <- Stn_dt[,
                    lapply(.SD, function(x) ifelse(all(is.na(x)),0,1)),
                    by=.(.id), .SDcols = indcols]
to_table1

```

Datasets were downloaded from the ICES-WKBENTH4 Sharepoint on 12 February 2026. Indicators were provided by workshop participants and included: `r paste(indcols, collapse=", ")`(@tbl-pressure_state).

Type-2 data are pressure-gradient data with minimal environmental variation. Datasets were only analyzed for samples across a fishing pressure gradient ranging from low/none to high fishing intensity. Low-pressure samples were identified using the 15 % quantiles. The threshold for low pressure is set by the data provider and may result in high values. The 15 % quantile was nevertheless considered as reference for low pressure. To enable comparability across indicators and datasets, each indicator value was standardized by dividing its value by the mean value of the indicators for the low-disturbance samples.

The pressure-state relationships were estimated by fitting a log-normal model with the logarithm of each indicator as a linear function of pressure: 
$$
\log(\text{indicator}) = \beta \cdot \text{pressure} + \varepsilon
$$
with $\varepsilon_i \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)$.

```{r Identifying significant pressure state relationships}
# Stn_dt$.id[!grepl("_and", Stn_dt$.id)]
# unique(Stn_dt$.id[!grepl("_and", Stn_dt$.id)])

Stn_dt[,gear_cat := ifelse(gear %in% unique(Stn_dt$gear)[grepl("trawl",tolower(unique(Stn_dt$gear)))],
                           "trawl",
                           ifelse(gear %in% unique(Stn_dt$gear)[grepl("veen|hamon|day|sm|core",tolower(unique(Stn_dt$gear)))],
                                  "grab",NA))]
ind_dt <- Stn_dt[!grepl("_and", Stn_dt$.id)] # Exclude datasets with multiple pressures

# Warning in selind = rel margalef div (biom), .id = NS_LongForties_btrawling: NaNs produced when running the log(resp_temp) below.
ind_dt[.id=="NS_LongForties_btrawling" & `rel margalef div (biom)`] # => rel margalef div (biom) is set to zero.
ind_dt[.id=="NS_LongForties_btrawling" & `rel margalef div (biom)`<0]$`rel margalef div (biom)` <- 1e-6

ind_dt[, sos := ifelse(sos=="NA"|is.na(sos), NA, sos)]
ind_dt[, sos:=as.numeric(sos)]

# to_report: Estimate the mean biom_Ksens for the reference samples
ind_dt[,
       `:=` (refpres_Q15  = round(quantile(pressure_value, .15),2)),
             by = .(.id, gear_cat, pressure_type)]
ind_dt[, ref := pressure_value <= refpres_Q15]

selindcols <- indcols[!grepl("_to_ref", indcols)]
ind_dt[, paste0("mean_", selindcols) := 
         lapply(.SD, function(x) mean(x[ref == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE)),
       by = .(.id, pressure_type, gear_cat),
       .SDcols = selindcols]
# Compute relative to reference mean for each indicator
ind_dt[, paste0(selindcols, "_to_ref") := Map(function(ind, meancol) {get(ind) / get(meancol)},
                                              ind = selindcols,
                                              meancol = paste0("mean_", selindcols)
                                              )]
ind_dt[, (paste0("mean_", selindcols)) := NULL]
# Convert all _to_ref columns to numeric
indcols <- names(ind_dt)[grepl("_to_ref", names(ind_dt))]
# ind_dt[, (indcols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) as.numeric(unlist(x))), .SDcols = indcols]

PSind_dt <- data.table()
for(selind in indcols[!grepl("total_biomass_withceph",indcols)]){
  # selind <- "longlivedbiomass_to_ref"
  selrows <- which(!is.na(ind_dt[[selind]]))
  temp <- ind_dt[selrows,]  # Exclude datasets where the indicator was not estimated
  temp[,resp_tmp := as.numeric(get(selind))]
  temp <- temp[!is.na(resp_tmp) & is.finite(resp_tmp)]
  # cat(class(temp$pressure_value), "\n")
  # cat(any(is.na(temp$pressure_value)), "\n")
  # cat(selind, "\n")
  tempout <- temp[,
                  {# Fit GLM on logit scale
                    m <- glm(log(resp_tmp+1e-6) ~ 0 + pressure_value, family = gaussian)
                    s <- summary(m)
                    # Store intercept, slope, p-value, 15% quantile
                    resp_int <- coef(m)["(Intercept)"]
                    resp_slope <- coef(m)["pressure_value"]
                    resp_se    <- summary(m)$coefficients["pressure_value", "Std. Error"]
                    slope_lwr <- resp_slope - 1.96 * resp_se
                    slope_upr <- resp_slope + 1.96 * resp_se
                    pval <- s$coefficients["pressure_value","Pr(>|t|)"]
                    refpres_Q15 <- round(quantile(pressure_value, .15),2)
                    max_pres <- max(pressure_value, na.rm=T)
                    
                    # Create prediction grid
                    x_seq <- seq(0, 100, by = 0.01)
                    pred <- predict(m, newdata = data.frame(pressure_value = x_seq),
                                    type = "response", se.fit = TRUE)
                    # Compute 95% CI on logit scale
                    log_fit <- pred$fit
                    log_se  <- pred$se.fit
                    log_upper <- log_fit + 1.96 * log_se
                    log_lower <- log_fit - 1.96 * log_se
                    
                    # Back-transform to 0-1 scale
                    resp_fit   <- exp(log_fit)
                    resp_se   <- exp(log_se)
                    resp_upper <- exp(log_upper)
                    resp_lower <- exp(log_lower)
                    
                    # # What SAR at the threshold?
                    # SAR_at_THR_pred = (log(unique(SEL_THR) + 1e-6)) / resp_slope  # THRESHOLD MUST BE SPECIFIC BY .id, gear_cat, pressure_type
                    # SAR_at_THR_lower <- (log(unique(SEL_THR) + 1e-6)) / slope_upr
                    # SAR_at_THR_upper <- (log(unique(SEL_THR) + 1e-6)) / slope_lwr
                    
                    # Return as a data.table
                    .(pressure_value = x_seq,
                      y_pred = resp_fit,
                      y_lower = resp_lower,
                      y_upper = resp_upper,
                      resp_se=exp(log_se),
                      resp_int = resp_int,
                      resp_slope = resp_slope,
                      pval = pval,
                      refpres_Q15 = refpres_Q15,
                      # SAR_at_THR_lower=SAR_at_THR_lower,
                      # SAR_at_THR_pred=SAR_at_THR_pred,
                      # SAR_at_THR_upper=SAR_at_THR_upper,
                      max_pres = max_pres
                      )
                    },
                  by = .(.id, gear_cat, pressure_type)]
  tempout$ind <- selind
  PSind_dt <- rbind(PSind_dt, tempout)
  }
PSind_dt

```


```{r to report}
# to_report: 
selcols <- c(".id","gear_cat","pressure_type","ind","resp_slope","pval","refpres_Q15") # , "SAR_at_THR_pred", "SAR_at_THR_lower", "SAR_at_THR_upper"
slopes <- unique(PSind_dt[,..selcols])
selcols <- c(".id","gear_cat","pressure_type")
to_table2 <- unique(PSind_dt[,..selcols])
to_table2 <- to_table2[slopes[order(pval, decreasing=F)], on=c(".id","gear_cat","pressure_type")]
num_cols <- names(to_table2)[sapply(to_table2, is.numeric)]
num_cols <- num_cols[!num_cols %in% c("pval")]
to_table2[, (num_cols) := lapply(.SD, round, digits = 2), .SDcols = num_cols]
to_table2[, ("pval") := lapply(.SD, round, digits = 7), .SDcols = "pval"]
to_table2 <- to_table2[order(ind, pval)]
to_table2[, signif := ifelse(pval<0.05,"*","NS")]
# sort(unique(to_table2$pressure_type))

# dcast(to_table2, .id + gear_cat + signif ~  ind, value.var="resp_slope")
to_table2[, slope_rep := ifelse(signif=="NS","NS",resp_slope)]
to_table2 <- dcast(to_table2, .id + gear_cat ~ ind, value.var="slope_rep")

# Rank datasets by number of indicators that show a decreasing indicator with increasing fishing pressure
to_table2[,`:=` (cnt=rowSums(!is.na(.SD)),
                 neg_slope=rowSums(.SD<0, na.rm=T),
                 perc_neg_slope_ind=round(rowSums(.SD<0, na.rm=T)/rowSums(.SD!="/", na.rm=T)*100,0)),
          .SDcols=indcols[!grepl("total_biomass_withceph",indcols)]]
to_table2 <- to_table2[order(-perc_neg_slope_ind)]
to_table2

# Estimate for each indicator: (1) the number of datasets for which it was estimated
# (2) the number of decreasing trends and (3) the percentage of decreasing trends
perc_neg_slope_ind <- to_table2[, lapply(.SD, function(x) {
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  neg_count  <- sum(num < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  numeric_count <- sum(!is.na(num))
  ns_count <- sum(x == "NS", na.rm = TRUE)
  denom <- numeric_count + ns_count
  if (denom == 0) return(NA_real_)
  .(nr_datasets = denom,
    nr_neg_slope = neg_count,
    perc_neg_slope = round(100 * neg_count / denom,0))
}), .SDcols = indcols[!grepl("total_biomass_withceph",indcols)]]
# Ensure all columns exist in perc_neg_slope_ind
missing_cols <- setdiff(names(to_table2), names(perc_neg_slope_ind))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  perc_neg_slope_ind[, (missing_cols) := ""]
}
cols_to_fill <- indcols[!grepl("total_biomass_withceph", indcols)]
for (col in cols_to_fill) {
  set(to_table2,
      i = which(is.na(to_table2[[col]])),
      j = col,
      value = "/")
}
perc_neg_slope_ind <- perc_neg_slope_ind[, lapply(.SD, unlist)]
selcols <- names(to_table2)
perc_neg_slope_ind <- perc_neg_slope_ind[,..selcols]
empty_row <- as.data.table(as.list(rep("", ncol(to_table2))))
setnames(empty_row, names(to_table2))
to_table2 <- rbindlist(list(to_table2,
                            empty_row,
                            perc_neg_slope_ind))
to_table2$.id <- c(gsub("_btrawling","",to_table2$.id[1:(length(to_table2$.id)-3)]),
                   "N(id)", "N(neg slope)","%(neg slope)")

selcols <- indcols[!grepl("total_biomass_withceph",indcols)]

colorder <- c(".id", "gear_cat",
              names(sort(unlist(to_table2[.id=="%(neg slope)", ..selcols]), decreasing = T)),
              "cnt","neg_slope","perc_neg_slope_ind")
to_table2 <- to_table2[,..colorder]
# to_table2

```


Pressure-state relationships were tested for `r length(indcols[!grepl("total_biomass_withceph",indcols)])` indicators. A negative slope implied a decrease in indicator in function of increasing fishing pressure. Indicators with a decreasing state with increasing fishing pressures in at least half of the tested datasets were `r paste(gsub("_to_ref","",names(to_table2))[suppressWarnings(which(as.numeric(to_table2[.id=="%(neg slope)"]) >=50))], collapse=", ")`



```{r pressure-state-table, include=TRUE}
#| label: tbl-pressure_state
#| tbl-cap: "Significant (P>0.05) slopes of the pressure-state relationships for all indicators and datasets. NS = No significant relationship; / = Indicator not estimated."
#| tbl-pos: H


# Define headers in the correct order with multi-line support
new_headers <- c(
  ".id" = "Dataset\nID",
  "gear_cat" = "Sampling\nGear",
  "total_biomass_to_ref" = "Total Biomass",
  "sos_2026_to_ref" = "SOS2026",
  "rel margalef div (dens)_to_ref" = "Relative Margaleff\n(Density)",
  "longlivedbiomass_to_ref" = "Long-lived\nBiomass",
  "invsimpson_to_ref" = "Inverse\nSimpson",
  "medlong_to_ref" = "Median\nLongevity",
  "shannon_to_ref" = "Shannon",
  "richness_to_ref" = "Richness",
  "fraclong_to_ref" = "Long-lived\nFraction",
  "simpson_to_ref" = "Simpson",
  "sos_to_ref" = "SOS",
  "total_abundance_to_ref" = "Total\nAbundance",
  "rel margalef div (biom)_to_ref" = "Relative Margaleff\n(Biomass)",
  "cnt" = "N\n(Indicators)",
  "neg_slope" = "N\n(Neg. Slopes)",
  "perc_neg_slope_ind" = "% \n(Neg. Slopes)"
)

# Order headers to match the table columns
headers_ordered <- new_headers[names(to_table2)]

# Print table
kable(to_table2,
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = TRUE,
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = headers_ordered,
      align = rep("c", ncol(to_table2))
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("scale_down", "repeat_header"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "5cm", latex_valign = "m") %>%   # first column wider
  column_spec(2:ncol(to_table2), width = "2.2cm", latex_valign = "m")
```

```{r plot pressure-state across indicators}

PSind_dt[, ind := factor(ind,
                         levels = PSind_dt$ind %>% unique(),
                         labels = gsub("_to_ref", "", PSind_dt$ind %>% unique()))]


linewidths <- rep(0.5, length(levels(PSind_dt$ind)))
names(linewidths) <- levels(PSind_dt$ind)
linewidths[c("total_biomass","sos_2026", "longlivedbiomass", "rel margalef div (dens)")] <- 1

ggplot(data=PSind_dt[pressure_value <= max_pres & 
                       !(.id %in% c("BS_southernbaltic_oxygendepletion","WMS_IMPEC_btrawling"))]) +
  geom_line(aes(x=pressure_value, y=y_pred,
                color = ind, linewidth = ind)) +
  facet_wrap(gear_cat ~ .id, scales = "free") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype=2, col="grey33") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x)sprintf("%.2f", x)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Indicator",
                     values=c("#4E79A7", "#F28E2B", "#E15759", "#76B7B2", "#59A14F",
                              "#EDC948", "#B07AA1", "#FF9DA7", "#9C755F", "#BAB0AC",
                              "#8CD17D", "#D6A0F0", "#FABFD2"),
                     labels=levels(PSind_dt$ind)) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(name = "Indicator",
                         values = linewidths,
                         labels=levels(PSind_dt$ind)) +
  theme_bw() +
  # theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Log-normal Regression with 95% CI of indicator relative to the mean of the low-disturbance samples",
       subtitle = "Low disturbance samples were estimated from the 15% quantile of the dataset-specific pressure values",
       y = "Standardized indicator values",
       x = "SAR (except ns_silverpit_btrawling: trawling index)")

ggplot2::ggsave(paste0("./output/pressure_state_indicators/all_indicators.png"), unit="cm",width=30,height=20)
```

```{r plot pressure-state by indicator}

for(selind in levels(PSind_dt$ind)){
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(data=ind_dt[!is.na(get(paste0(selind,"_to_ref"))) & !(.id %in% "BS_southernbaltic_oxygendepletion")],
             aes(x=pressure_value, y=get(paste0(selind,"_to_ref")), shape = factor(ref))) +
  geom_line(data=PSind_dt[pressure_value <= max_pres & ind==selind & !(.id %in% "BS_southernbaltic_oxygendepletion")],
            aes(x=pressure_value, y=y_pred),
            color = "#1F5AA6", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(data=PSind_dt[pressure_value <= max_pres & ind==selind & !(.id %in% "BS_southernbaltic_oxygendepletion")],
              aes(x=pressure_value, ymin = y_lower, ymax = y_upper), fill = "#1F5AA6", alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(gear_cat ~ .id, scales = "free") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype=2, col="grey33") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x)sprintf("%.2f", x)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = paste("Log-normal Regression with 95% CI of indicator:",gsub("_"," ",selind),"\n to mean over reference samples", sep=" "),
       y = selind,
       x = "SAR (except ns_silverpit_btrawling: trawling index)")
  ggplot2::ggsave(paste0("./output/pressure_state_indicators/",gsub("[ ()]", "_", selind),".png"), unit="cm",width=30,height=20)
}
```
